name: Zephyr Sites
tagline: Deploy, update and roll back static sites on Zephyr Cloud by chat
description: Connects to your Zephyr Cloud account once, then handles static-site work from the conversation: pushing a deploy, shipping an update, or rolling back a release that went wrong. When a target organisation has to be chosen it asks you to pick, and everything else is requested in plain language.
